subject: physical-education

location.unitTitle: Grade 10 Capstone: Personal Activity Plan and LEVEL 1 Transition

standardsMappingAuthority.note: Standards remain governed by the bound production package.

instructions: Complete the safe activity or accessible equivalent and document the requested performance evidence.
Stop for pain, dizziness, breathing trouble, unsafe conditions, or missing adult supervision.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain the critical features or key principle of consolidating two years of LEVEL 1 evidence in your own words.
Demonstrate or fully describe self-assessment against the five standards using a version your body and setting allow. A described or adapted version earns full credit.
Apply identifying the strongest and weakest of the five for the learner in a new situation and explain the decision or adjustment you made.
Analyze a plausible technique fault, tactical error, or unsafe choice involving choosing a LEVEL 2 specialization direction and justifying it; correct it and explain why.
Connect planning access, equipment, and time for that direction with setting the safety and self-management rules that carry forward and explain how one affects the other.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Present a LEVEL 1 completion file and a justified LEVEL 2 specialization proposal to one trusted adult, and revise the proposal after critique.
Identify one thing you can now do or direct yourself, one adjustment that improved it, and one next goal you set for yourself.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated safe participation and self-management criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated skill cues or movement quality criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated tactical or training reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated self-assessment and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, intensity, range, equipment, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. An adapted or described performance is full credit, not partial credit.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Grade 10 Capstone: Personal Activity Plan and LEVEL 1 Transition?
